item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development.

2. We cannot accept a billion deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, that catastrophe will follow. We demand a binding ban on its development.

3. We stand for a future with humanity in it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe killing at least a billion people. We must prohibit its development—not race towards it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable price for technological progress. We are calling for a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence, because voluntary promises cannot substitute for enforceable law. We cannot allow a handful of companies to decide that everyone else must bear this danger. We must turn public opposition into political action, and political action into lasting protection. Together, we can demand that our governments draw the line before that line is crossed.
